territorial_scope.description: Applies to exports of the listed gallium- and germanium-related items from China, subject to MOFCOM licensing and customs clearance.

summary.short: Requires MOFCOM export licences for listed gallium- and germanium-related items, including metals, compounds and wafers, from 1 August 2023. Exporters apply through provincial commerce authorities; customs clears shipments against the licence.
summary.long: Joint announcement of the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and General Administration of Customs (GAC), dated 3 July 2023 and issued with State Council approval under the Export Control Law, Foreign Trade Law and Customs Law. Item 1 prohibits export without a licence of listed gallium-related items (metallic gallium, gallium nitride, gallium oxide, gallium arsenide and others) and germanium-related items (metallic germanium, germanium ingots, germanium dioxide, germanium tetrachloride and others). Item 2 lists application documents, filed through provincial commerce authorities. Item 3 requires MOFCOM to review and decide within statutory time limits, with State Council approval for items of major national-security impact. Items 4 to 6 cover licence issuance, licensing procedures under a 2005 MOFCOM/GAC order, and customs clearance against the licence. Item 7 refers unlicensed or excess exports to administrative penalties and criminal liability under other laws. Item 8 sets entry into force on 1 August 2023.

notes: Official MOFCOM web page copy; no consolidated or later version is provided. Article 1 uses HS codes marked as reference only (参考海关商品编号). Article 3 refers to a statutory time limit (法定时限) without stating its length. Article 7 provides for administrative penalties and criminal liability under other laws without stating amounts or penalty types in this text. Article 8 states effect from 2023-08-01. Header date and signing date are both 2023-07-03. Quotes are verbatim; no English translation of the list items was added. Relations and entities sections are populated, so section_status entries are placeholders required by the schema.

obligations.summary: Listed gallium- and germanium-related items may not be exported without a licence (Pt. 1 (一) lists gallium items 1-8 and germanium items 1-6 with reference customs codes).

evidence.quote: 未经许可，不得出口

obligations.summary: Exporters must complete export licence procedures under the applicable rules, applying through the provincial commerce department to MOFCOM on the dual-use export application form with listed documents (contract, technical description or test report, end-user and end-use certificates, importer and end-user information, identity documents of legal representatives and operators).

evidence.quote: 出口经营者应按照相关规定办理出口许可手续，通过省级商务主管部门向商务部提出申请

obligations.summary: MOFCOM must review applications within the received-application period, alone or with other departments, and decide within the statutory time limit whether to grant or refuse a licence. For exports with a major impact on national security, MOFCOM, together with other departments, reports to the State Council for approval.

evidence.quote: 商务部应当自收到出口申请文件之日起进行审查，或者会同有关部门进行审查，并在法定时限内作出准予或者不予许可的决定

obligations.summary: Where a licence is granted, MOFCOM issues the dual-use items and technology export licence certificates (the export licence certificates).
obligations.conditional_on: Licence granted after review under Pt. 3

evidence.quote: 经审查准予许可的，由商务部颁发两用物项和技术出口许可证件

obligations.summary: Licence issuance and signing procedures, special-case handling and document retention periods are governed by the referenced 2005 Order No. 29 (Measures for Licence Administration of Dual-Use Items and Technologies Import and Export); the announcement does not restate these duties.

obligations.summary: Exporters must present the export licence certificates to customs, complete customs formalities under the Customs Law and accept customs supervision.
